title: Normalized Provider Event v1
description: The executable producer-owned contract for the normalized, schema-versioned event emitted by fast-api-eda-gateway on the afk.events topic. Every consumer validates incoming messages against this schema.

schema_version.description: Producer schema version — always "1.0" for v1 messages.

delivery_id.description: Forwarded provider delivery UUID (X-GitHub-Delivery / X-GitLab-Event-UUID). The delivery_log dedup key on the consumer side.

resource_type.description: Producer-native resource vocabulary: issue, pull_request (GitHub), or merge_request (GitLab). Never the outcome layer's canonical change_request.

resource_id.description: Stable provider-scoped resource identity — the value behind the canonical entity_id (e.g. "442" for change_request:442).

action.description: Canonical event-type suffix: opened, closed, merged, review_requested, changes_requested, or approved.

occurred_at.description: When the activity happened at the source (ISO 8601).

ingested_at.description: Producer's ingest timestamp (ISO 8601). Optional — may be null when the producer has not yet recorded it.

actor.description: Acting principal login. Optional — may be null for automated events.

payload_ref.description: Reference to the redacted payload — never the payload itself. Optional — may be null when no payload reference is available.
